name: @oneearth/region-drilldown
description: 挂载到现有 Cesium Viewer 的行政区圆圈下钻前端插件

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:umd
scripts.build:esm: npx --yes esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --external:cesium --outfile=dist/region-drilldown.es.js --banner:js='/* OneEarth Region Drilldown v1.0.0 | Cesium is a peer dependency */'
scripts.build:umd: npx --yes esbuild src/umd.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=OneEarthRegionDrilldown --outfile=dist/region-drilldown.umd.js --banner:js='/* OneEarth Region Drilldown v1.0.0 | Requires window.Cesium */'
